calibration.rule: highest calibration recall with precision >= 0.9 on the boundaries the segmenter did not cut; ties: higher precision, longer duration, higher threshold
calibration.selected_on: calibration boundaries the segmenter did not cut

treatment: a wasl-dependent item at a boundary judged a pause is waqf_realized: no site of its stratum, out of every evaluation denominator; its verdict stays a training target (heard)
